welcome.label: Introduction
welcome.card1Body: Breadcrumb is a learning companion. Anything you are trying to understand can be discussed here with an AI; alongside the answers, what the conversation covered is recorded automatically. There are no notes to take and no daily check-in.
welcome.card2Body: Every concept that comes up becomes an island on a map, placed and grouped automatically. Areas untouched for a while go pale, which shows which parts have been set aside, not how well you are doing.
welcome.card3Title: Where the data stays, and what costs money
welcome.card3Body: Conversations, the map and the vocabulary are all stored on this computer. There is no account and no cloud sync. The only thing that costs money is the AI service you supply yourself, billed by usage; every feature that spends anything can be switched off on its own, with the price written beside it in settings.
welcome.demoNote: The example is a three-month learning record and can be removed in one step.

tour.label: Guided tour
tour.chatBody: Entering text here is all that is required. In the switch above, Study mode replies guide you to think and practise, and Free chat is an ordinary conversation.
tour.trailTitle: Chats are listed in the sidebar
tour.trailBody: Titles are generated automatically, in the form "first concept to last concept". Once a title is renamed by hand, it is never changed again.
tour.mapBody: These islands were assembled from the conversations automatically; nothing was recorded by hand. Scrolling up goes one level in.
tour.mapEmptyTitle: This is open sea for now
tour.mapEmptyBody: The concepts covered in each exchange become islands here automatically. Nothing has to be recorded by hand.
tour.mirrorBody: These two panels show how much has been learned and how much is still remembered. Parts untouched for a long time fade on their own; this is a note, not a penalty. Everything on this page is computed on this machine and costs nothing.
tour.spendingBody: Every feature that costs money is on this page and can be switched off on its own. The approximate cost of one use is written here before it is turned on, and that figure is measured rather than estimated.
tour.yourTurnBody: Ask about something you genuinely want to understand. The map follows on its own.

chat.title: Talking to the AI
chat.body: Ask about anything you want to understand. The switch above decides how replies come back: study mode asks questions in return and invites you to explain things yourself, while free chat is an ordinary back-and-forth.
chat.point1: Concepts that come up are filed into the map automatically, with nothing to record by hand
chat.point2: Chat titles are generated automatically and stop changing once renamed by hand
chat.limit: It does not plan a timetable, and it does not send reminders after a few days away.

map.title: A map of what has been learned
map.body: Each island is a concept that has been discussed, placed and grouped automatically. Going one level in shows the detail, including which conversations touched it.
map.point1: Darker places were touched recently; pale ones have been set aside for a while
map.point2: Everything on this page is computed on this machine and costs nothing
map.limit: It is not a notebook: entries cannot be added by hand, and the map only grows out of conversations.

vocab.title: Learning a language while chatting
vocab.body: Once this is on, some words in the AI's replies arrive in the language being learned, and can be guessed at before the definition is shown. This page lists the words in progress and is where dictionaries are downloaded and switched.
vocab.point1: A vocabulary check can be taken first, so new words start from the level already reached
vocab.point2: Pronunciation and definitions come from a downloaded dictionary that stays on this machine and works offline
vocab.limit: It does not teach grammar or provide sets of exercises; it only swaps words into sentences you were going to read anyway.

discovery.title: Everyday viewing, gathered on one page
discovery.body: Once a browser script is installed, what you watch on Bilibili and YouTube is gathered here: the words that keep appearing, topics that have come up recently, and the longer content watched. All of it is processed on this computer.
discovery.point1: This page opens before any script is installed, and lists the steps required
discovery.point2: The viewing record stays on this machine and is never sent elsewhere
discovery.limit: It does not decide what to watch, and it does not score what has been watched.

companions.title: Companions who come with questions
companions.body: A few characters come by each day with questions drawn from recently learned material. Explaining something to them is a way to check whether it can be explained clearly. These conversations run in a separate small window and do not affect the existing chat.
companions.point1: What they ask about is drawn from your own learning record
companions.point2: The whole feature can be switched off in settings
companions.limit: They are not real people; once you leave they do not wait and do not call you back.

settings.title: Keys, languages and spending
settings.body: The first step is entering the address and key of an AI service, without which the features that depend on the AI cannot run. This page also changes the interface language, the language the AI answers in, and whether the app goes online at all.
settings.point1: Switches and spending lists every feature that costs money, each with its own switch and the approximate cost of one use
settings.point2: The key is stored on this computer only and is never sent out with anything
settings.limit: The AI service itself is not provided here; the key has to be obtained from a provider.
